layout.arrangement: A single framed slide (thin red rectangle border, approx. x 6%-95%, y 8%-96%) on a white page. Top-center: red bold title 'Neural Network Model' with a blue bold parenthetical subtitle directly beneath it. Top-left inside the frame: a small magenta-filled box 'Input Sample'; top-right: a matching magenta-filled box 'Target Label', plus a yellow circular badge '17' above/right of it. The middle ~45% of the slide is a large pale-cream panel containing a left-to-right, three-row neural-network schematic: magenta input dots at far left → red Σ nodes → activation squares → blue Σ nodes (previous layer i) → green Σ nodes (current layer j) → orange Σ nodes (next layer k) → blue-outlined 'Output 1/2/m' boxes → a tall dark-red vertical 'Error Error Error' bar → green 'Class 1/2/m' boxes at far right. A band below the network (~y 70-82%) contains magenta bias circles ('1', 'Node Bias'), three outlined up-arrows (blue, green, orange) and three layer-name boxes ('Previous Layer / Layer (i)', 'Current Layer / (You are here)', 'Next Layer / Layer (K)'), with the red italic notes 'For Layer “j”' at left and 'Note: Layer “j” is NOT Output Layer' at right. Bottom-left: a pale-yellow bordered equation box with two formulas; bottom-right: a matching equation box with the error formula and three red X marks.

visual_elements.description: Full neural-network back-propagation schematic on a pale-cream panel, three horizontal neuron rows (top row y≈170, middle row y≈235, bottom row y≈310). LEFT: three small solid magenta input dots stacked at x≈75 (y≈210, 230, 270) with faint gray/pink fan-out lines to the first layer. PREVIOUS LAYER (i): each row has a white circle with red outline containing 'Σ' (x≈137), a small solid red dot (x≈157), a small white square containing a red sigmoid curve (x≈185), two small pale unfilled circles (x≈200 and x≈215), a white circle with blue outline containing 'Σ' (x≈240), a small solid red dot (x≈262), a white square with red sigmoid curve (x≈305) with red italic label 'Net_i' above it, and a small solid red dot (x≈320) with red label 'O_i' above. CURRENT LAYER (j): a yellow circle labeled 'W_ij' in blue (x≈355) sits on the connection from O_i to a white circle with green outline containing 'Σ' (x≈400); a yellow circle labeled 'Net' in red (x≈430) sits on the connection to a white square with green sigmoid curve (x≈460); a solid red dot (x≈475) with red label 'O_j' above. NEXT LAYER (k): a yellow circle labeled 'W_jk' in blue (x≈505) on the connection to a white circle with orange outline containing 'Σ' (x≈545); a yellow circle labeled 'Net' in red (x≈575); a white square with orange sigmoid curve (x≈605); a solid red dot (x≈620) with red label 'O_k' above. CONNECTIONS: faint light-pink fully-connected lines fan from every O_i node to every green Σ node and from every O_j node to every orange Σ node; blue dashed arrows with rotated blue labels 'W_ij' run from each O_i dot to the green Σ of the same row; blue dashed arrows with rotated blue labels 'W_jk' run from each O_j dot to the orange Σ of the same row; black dashed skip-connection arcs arc over the top of the diagram from the O_i/O_j nodes to the orange Σ nodes (three arcs converging on the top orange Σ, plus a dashed arc rising from the bottom-row O_j to the middle orange Σ). OUTPUTS: blue-outlined white boxes 'Output 1' (x≈675, y≈170), 'Output 2' (x≈675, y≈235), 'Output m' (x≈675, y≈310). ERROR: three blue dashed arrows curve from each O_k dot to a tall dark-red vertical bar (x≈740, y≈140-340) carrying rotated white text 'Error Error Error'. CLASSES: light-green boxes 'Class 1' (y≈170), 'Class 2' (y≈235), 'Class m' (y≈310) at x≈790. A small black arrow/pointer artifact sits near x≈700, y≈290 pointing down-right.
